intent.caption: Glass prism refraction — A dispersive glass prism over a dark scene: iridescence, back rim light, emissive core — never flat glassmorphism.

visualSpec.effects: Triangular prism: equilateral cross-section 1.2 units per side, length 1.8 units, axis horizontal, rotated 12 deg on z and 20 deg on y, centered at origin. Material: MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission 1.0, thickness 0.9, ior 1.55, TSL dispersion pass splitting refraction by 0.18 across RGB, iridescence 1.0, iridescenceIOR 1.3, iridescenceThicknessRange [120,480] nm, roughness 0.08, clearcoat 0.25, clearcoatRoughness 0.1, attenuationColor #e8ecf2 attenuationDistance 2.5. Emissive core: 0.35-unit octahedron inside the prism, color #ff2a38, emissive #ff2a38 intensity 2.2 (kept under the 2.5 AgX red-clip ceiling). Back rim: strong cool directional from behind-left so both long edges carry a bright rim line. Caustic streak: 2.4 x 0.5-unit plane on the floor at y=-1.1 with an engineered linear gradient of dispersed stops (#ff2a38 at 0.2, #e8ecf2 at 0.5, #9fb0c4 at 0.8) at opacity 0.35, elongating 8 percent when the prism tilts. Hover depth-rotate: up to 10 deg toward cursor over 350ms cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1); release weighted-settle 1.04 to 1.0 over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1). Headline baseline 1.75 units (7x base) below center, caption 0.5 units below it. Never flat glassmorphism: no frosted planes, no uniform white borders.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Prism tilts up to 10 deg toward the cursor on hover and settles with weighted overshoot; the dispersed caustic streak on the floor elongates as it tilts.
